# RC Surface 2.0.1

Maintenance update for offline panel recovery and LAN connections, including Macs with Apple Silicon.

- The panel embeds every local script and its font when the server is stopped. Start, Close and the automatic-start preference work without an HTTP server.
- The default QR prefers known physical interfaces over virtual bridges and VPNs. Network address in the panel lets you choose another announced private address while preserving the HTTPS port and full performance session URL. The admin connection stays on loopback. Newly appeared addresses are not offered until the certificate covers them; restart the server after changing networks.
- Existing 2.0 mappings, presets and projects remain compatible. Install 2.0.1 and reload the browser; no data reset is required.
- Install AbletonOSC in Remote Scripts inside your User Library so it survives Live updates. REC and SYNC require it.

Download `RC-Surface-2.0.1.ablx` and the unchanged `RC-Midi-Receiver.amxd` and optional `RC-Audio-Sender.amxd`. Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`, install the ABLX and restart Live if necessary. Live Suite Beta with Extensions is required. Automated validation does not replace a recording/playback check on the target Mac.

[Install](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · [User Guide](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md) · [Compatibility](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

## Em português

Atualização de manutenção para recuperar o painel offline e conectar pela rede local, inclusive em Macs com Apple Silicon.

- O painel incorpora os scripts e a fonte quando o servidor está parado. Start, Close e a preferência de início automático continuam funcionando.
- O QR prioriza interfaces físicas conhecidas. Endereço de rede permite escolher outro IP privado anunciado, mantendo HTTPS, porta e URL de sessão. A administração continua no loopback. IPs novos só aparecem quando cobertos pelo certificado; reinicie o servidor depois de trocar de rede.
- Mappings, presets e projetos 2.0 continuam compatíveis. Instale e recarregue o navegador; não é preciso zerar dados.
- Instale AbletonOSC em Remote Scripts dentro da User Library. REC e SYNC precisam dele.

Confira os hashes antes de instalar. O teste de gravar e reproduzir um take no Mac de destino continua necessário.
